name_reason: Current name is a misnomer on two counts. (1) It implies a portrait sprite-cache value, but this global has nothing to do with the portrait cache: the real portrait-cache fill counter is the separate sibling data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_count @ 0x53BDF (driven by fd2_load_portrait_to_cache). The existing src comment already flags this ('Despite the legacy name, this is NOT the portrait sprite cache size'). (2) '_offset' implies a byte offset, but the value is a record COUNT -- the number of field-character spawn records loaded from FDFIELD.DAT tile_event_data_table[2]. Proposed name keeps the existing data_fd2_resource_ domain (consistent with the load-block siblings at 0x53BDF/0x53BE7) and accurately states it is a count of field-character records. No Ghidra address residue in either name (no hex suffix). Rename only RECORDED here; Stage 2 applies it across protos/globals.h + all call sites.
purpose: Per-chapter count of field-character spawn records (chapter NPC/enemy/recruit definitions), read from the 3rd byte of the loaded FDFIELD.DAT tile-event table header (tile_event_data_table[2]).
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS scalar. Written (MOVZX byte -> MOV dword) on every chapter/save load path: fd2_load_chapter_battle_data @ 0x10991 and fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x10291, both as = (uint32)tile_event_data_table[2]. Consumed at 32-bit width in two dual roles: (a) loop bound in fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp @ 0x10BCC scanning tile-event records 0..count (stride 0x1A, race byte at +0x98) and spawning each matching-race entry via fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle; (b) position-table index base in fd2_load_chapter_battle_data @ 0x10A5B (IMUL count,6 -> field_pos = chapter_portrait_load_buffer + count*6 + 2), so player-party positions begin after these N field-character position records.
element_semantics: Single unsigned scalar: number of field-character spawn records for the current chapter (0..255 in practice; widened from a byte at write time, used signed as a loop bound and multiplied by 6 as a position-table stride base).
